company.name: LatchBio
company.shortDescription: LatchBio is a biotech research company that provides code-free platform for the biocomputing revolution.
company.description: LatchBio develops a data infrastructure intended to build and disseminate the open-source infrastructure of the biocomputing revolution. Founded in 2021 by Alfredo Andere, Kyle Giffin, and Kenny Workman, the company creates open-source machine learning and cloud infrastructure for the next generation of therapeutic discovery, thereby enabling biotech companies to find therapies faster and save on engineering.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based, code-free biocomputing platform that connects biological data, metadata, workflows, scalable compute, visualizations, and collaborative analysis in one workspace.
productsAndServices.name: LatchBio Platform

productsAndServices.description: AI agents for analyzing biological datasets and assisting with code, visualizations, workflows, and scientific interpretation in a cloud-based research environment.
productsAndServices.name: Latch Agents

productsAndServices.description: An interactive deployment environment where users can apply AI agents to biological data analysis through a browser-based sandbox.
productsAndServices.name: Agent.bio

productsAndServices.description: Customizable analysis portals that let sequencing, assay, kit, and instrument providers deliver branded data-processing and reporting experiences to their customers.
productsAndServices.name: White-Labeled Analysis Portals for Solution Providers

productsAndServices.description: Biosecurity evaluation and risk-assessment services for frontier AI and biology systems, including benchmarks, audits, red-teaming, and automated identity checks.
productsAndServices.name: Latch Biosecurity

productsAndServices.description: An end-to-end cloud workflow for processing ATAC-seq data, from sequencing reads and quality control through peak calling, annotation, visualization, and interpretation.
productsAndServices.name: ATAC-seq Analysis Solution

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: LatchBio combines LatchBio Platform with Latch Agents.
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $28,000,000, or 84.34% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds

insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
